siteMaintenance.title: Site Maintenance
siteMaintenance.enableHint: When on, every request to the player site returns 503. The backoffice (admin panel) is unaffected.
siteMaintenance.enableConfirmTitle: Switch the site into maintenance mode?
siteMaintenance.enableConfirmContent: Enabling this blocks members from using the site, including logging in. The change takes effect within about 10 seconds.
siteMaintenance.currentlyOnBanner: Maintenance mode is currently ON. Players cannot use the site.
siteMaintenance.untilHint: This is only a label shown on screen. The site does NOT reopen automatically once this time passes — you must turn off maintenance mode above yourself.
siteMaintenance.allowIpsHint: Comma-separated. Listed IPs can still reach the site while maintenance is on.
siteMaintenance.yourIpHint: The response a blocked member receives includes their resolved IP (yourIp). Add your own IP to the allowlist and verify access before turning maintenance back off.

attendance.enabledHint: Turning this on shows the attendance menu/rewards to players and starts real payouts.

attendance.minDepositHint: Set to 0 to allow check-in with no deposit at all.
attendance.rolloverMultiplierHint: 1 = 100% of the reward must be wagered before withdrawal. Set to 0 to allow immediate withdrawal with no wagering.
attendance.rolloverMultiplierZeroWarning: Setting the multiplier to 0 removes the wagering requirement entirely — the reward becomes immediately-withdrawable cash. Set this carefully.
attendance.rewardsHint: Day numbers don't need to be contiguous (e.g. only days 1, 7, 15, 30 can be configured). Saving replaces the entire ladder with exactly the rows shown — any row you remove from the table is deleted.
attendance.emptyRewardsWarning: With no rewards configured, players will see nothing on the attendance screen.
